name: Nexg Bina Berhad
overview: 2026年，Nexg Bina Berhad 未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售事项；公告主要为财务报告、股东大会通知及重大诉讼。
overview_en: In 2026, Nexg Bina Berhad did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, or disposal of business segments in its announcements; announcements were mainly financial reports, general meeting notices, and material litigation.
